## Lifecycle checklist

- [ ] **Plan** — grilled the approach before coding
- [ ] **Spec/Tickets** — plan carried into a spec (small / single-agent) OR tickets (bigger / parallelized across agents)
- [ ] **TDD** — implemented with adversarial test-driven development (tests added/updated)
- [ ] **Review** — self / peer code-review pass done
- [ ] **Validate** — ran the suite + manual/functional check; green
